editorial_method: Primary-source review; no account or live workflow tested.

zh.summary: 面向电网接入与规划团队，把方案分析接到物理校核和工程复核。
zh.judgment: 需求来自工程队列和重复分析，价值必须建立在可验证计算而非自动生成报告上。
zh.replaces: 工程师整理接入申请、准备网络上下文，反复计算方案并写审批依据。
zh.product: 已核验官网描述申请接入、网络上下文、研究组合、物理检查及复核证据。具体软件接口、部署文档和公开价目尚未取得，不能声称已经替代完整电力仿真工具。
zh.customer: 电网连接与规划团队、数据中心和大型项目开发者是明确对象。使用者与最终工程批准人可能不同，采购需要看队列处理和复核成本。
zh.workflow: 公司描述将多方案分析并行化，指出计划失效位置并交给工程师选择。需要核验输入网络版本、计算约束和证据追溯，保留最终工程责任。
zh.business_model: 本次未确认商业价格和合同，项目或机构采购是商业假设。电网数据整理、模型适配和客户验证可能构成重交付，不能直接套用轻量 SaaS 经济。
zh.traction: 官网说明面向的流程与角色，但没有取得独立现场验证、具名付费项目或周期改善对照。并行方案数量也不等于可批准接入数量。
zh.moat: 领域模型、历史约束与工程工作流可能积累优势。传统规划软件、咨询和内部自动化都是替代，可靠计算与可复核接口比代理标签更重要。
zh.funding_read: 融资给予早期验证资源。下一里程碑应是同一工程团队接受计算结果并重复使用；提供方的融资口径不作为产品质量评分。
zh.risks: 错误网络数据或约束可能产生不可用方案，模型版本不同也可能影响结果。缺乏明确责任与复核证据会拖延机构采购。
zh.takeaway: 让自动分析输出可复核的物理检查与方案差异。把工程师审批路径嵌入产品，先缩短一种分析流程再扩大范围。
zh.watch_next: 看与参考计算的一致性、复核时间、被接受方案比例及实施工时。区分仿真运行速度和完整接入审批周期。

en.summary: Agentic grid planning connecting scenario analysis to physics checks and engineering review.
en.judgment: Queue pressure creates demand, but value rests on verifiable computation rather than generated reports.
en.replaces: Preparing applications and network context, repeatedly evaluating scenarios and writing review evidence.
en.product: The reviewed site describes intake, network context, study composition, physics checks and evidence. Interfaces, deployment documentation and prices were not obtained; replacement of full simulation tooling is unproven.
en.customer: Connection and planning teams, data centers and major developers are stated audiences. Users and approving engineers may differ; procurement should assess queue handling and review cost.
en.workflow: The company describes parallel scenarios and surfacing broken plans for engineers to choose. Network versions, constraints and provenance need verification while engineering responsibility remains explicit.
en.business_model: Commercial prices and contracts were not established. Project or institutional procurement is a hypothesis; data preparation, adaptation and validation may make delivery intensive.
en.traction: Roles and workflow are public, without independent field validation, named paid projects or cycle comparisons. Analyzed scenarios are not approved connections.
en.moat: Domain models, historical constraints and workflow integration could accumulate advantages. Planning software, consultants and internal automation compete on dependable computation and review.
en.funding_read: Early financing provides validation resources. Accepted calculations and repeated use within an engineering team are useful milestones; funding-data confidence is not product quality.
en.risks: Wrong network data or constraints can produce unusable plans. Version differences and unclear review responsibility may slow procurement.
en.takeaway: Output inspectable physics checks and scenario differences. Embed approval paths, shorten one analysis workflow, then broaden coverage.
en.watch_next: Watch agreement with reference calculations, review time, accepted scenarios and implementation effort. Simulation speed differs from the whole approval cycle.
